presentation.label: INPUT PRE SENDS
presentation.summary: Takes the external inputs’ delay and reverb sends before their LEV, and can keep the effects awake with no track playing, so the Digitakt works as an effects box.
presentation.overview: Stock, the Digitakt derives IN L and IN R’s delay and reverb sends from the level after their External Mixer LEV, so turning LEV down also silences what they send to the effects. With SETTINGS > INPUT SENDS PRE ticked, the inputs’ sends are taken before LEV instead (still after PAN): LEV sets only the dry inputs on the mains, and at LEV 0 the inputs reach the delay and reverb fully wet. The sends then match what stock sends at LEV 127. Stock, loading a project or pressing STOP twice also puts the delay and reverb on hold until an audio track trigs, so the inputs get no effect while nothing plays. With SETTINGS > KEEP FX AWAKE ticked, that hold releases itself as soon as its fade-out has finished: a double STOP still cuts the effects, and they come back for the inputs within about a second. Unticked, both rows leave the stock instructions running. Tracks 1-8, DUAL MONO and every other mixer setting are unchanged.
highlights: IN L and IN R send to the delay and reverb independently of their LEV.
LEV 0 gives a 100% wet input: the effects only, no dry signal on the mains.
KEEP FX AWAKE: the effects work on the inputs without a trig after a project load or a double STOP.
Unticked, each row is stock; tracks are never affected.
usage: Connect a source to IN L and IN R, open the External Mixer (FUNC + LFO until its page) and turn the inputs’ DEL or REV up.
Open SETTINGS and tick KEEP FX AWAKE. If the effects were on hold, they now answer the inputs within about a second, with no track playing.
Tick INPUT SENDS PRE and turn IN L and IN R LEV down to 0: the dry inputs go silent and the delay and reverb get them as if LEV were at full, 100% wet.
Raise LEV to blend the dry inputs back in; the sends stay the same. Press STOP twice to cut the effects at any time; with KEEP FX AWAKE ticked they come back by themselves.

access.location: SETTINGS > INPUT SENDS PRE, SETTINGS > KEEP FX AWAKE
steps: Use a build containing Input Pre-Fader Sends for the original Digitakt on OS 1.54.
Press SETTINGS and go down to INPUT SENDS PRE or KEEP FX AWAKE, the last two rows, with UP/DOWN.
Press YES to tick or untick a row. RIGHT ticks it and LEFT unticks it.
Press FUNC + LFO until the External Mixer page, and set IN L/IN R LEV, DEL and REV as usual.

controls.name: INPUT SENDS PRE
controls.doc: Ticked: IN L and IN R’s DEL and REV sends are taken before their LEV (after PAN), as at LEV 127. Unticked: stock post-fader sends. Unticked at every power-on; not saved with the project.

controls.name: KEEP FX AWAKE
controls.doc: Ticked: after a project load or a double STOP, the delay and reverb come back by themselves once their fade-out has finished (under a second in the emulator) instead of waiting for an audio track to trig, so the external inputs reach them with no track playing. A double STOP still cuts the effects. Unticked: stock. Unticked at every power-on; not saved with the project.

limitations: Neither setting is saved: both start unticked (stock) at every power-on and apply to every project and pattern. After power-on, tick KEEP FX AWAKE (and press STOP twice if the effects stay silent) to release the hold the boot sets.
PRE sends are taken after PAN, as the stock sends are.
KEEP FX AWAKE overrides a safety hold: with high delay feedback, inputs feeding the effects can build up again after a double STOP. Untick it to restore the stock hold.

load.display: Adds 0.2% average, 0.3% worst-case of an audio block over stock (emulator)
load.conditions: Emulator: OS 1.54 on Core 2.1, 3,000 audio blocks timed with the MCF5441x instruction-timing model at 250 MHz, zero-wait memory, both rows ticked. Stock: 60.3% average, 60.7% worst block; with the module 60.5% and 61.0% (both unticked 60.5% and 60.9%). The mixer handlers run on all ten channels and the hold check once, every block, so the cost does not depend on the pattern. Not a hardware measurement.

hardware.summary: draadpiraat flashed the module-alone build and a build with Digi Health and Digi EQ on their Digitakt I, OS 1.54. Module alone, all seven steps passed: the KEEP FX AWAKE row appears unticked; unticked the input effects stay silent after power-on until a trig, as stock; ticked they come back without a trig after a double STOP and after a project load; a double STOP still cuts the tail completely; unticked again it is stock; INPUT SENDS PRE still gives a fully wet input at LEV 0. With Digi Health and Digi EQ the same steps passed, except that the input effects were already awake at power-on with the row unticked; a control build of Digi Health and Digi EQ without this module showed the same, after 5-10 seconds. The author then played with it for about one to two hours without any issues.
limitations: Pattern changes and sampling from the inputs were not tested.
Firmware was not read back from the device; the builds are identified by their SysEx hashes.
Project load is tested by loading a project; KEEP FX AWAKE starts unticked at power-on, so it never acts on the boot hold.

tests.summary: Author hardware (Digitakt I, OS 1.54, module alone and with Digi Health and Digi EQ) and emulator: INPUT SENDS PRE as in 0.1.0; KEEP FX AWAKE releases the effects hold after a double STOP and a project load without a trig, the double STOP still cuts the tail, and unticked it is stock. Pattern changes and sampling not tested.
